question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is 'previous.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us discuss the meanings of the given options:

 
 
• Ancient: belonging to a period of history that is thousands of years in the past. (प्राचीन, पुरातन, हज़ारों वर्ष पुराना)
 
• **Olden**: relating to former times. (पूर्व काल से संबंधित)
 
• **Previous**: existing or occurring before in time or order. (समय या क्रम से पहले विद्यमान या घटित होना)
 
• **Elder**: (of one or more out of a group of associated people) of greater age. ((संबद्ध लोगों के समूह में से एक या अधिक का) अधिक आयु का)
 
 
 
• The given sentence is trying to convey that the older generation only switched to a new product when the former one's useful life ended.**
 

Correct Paragraph__: *While the older generation of Indians would buy a new product only when the (1) __**previous**__ one's useful life had ended, the young generation ______(2)______ to fall for novelty. Young people want the ______(3)______ gadgets because they have money and more ______(4)______ to such goods. They are made to believe, by ______(5)______ publicity, that the new products will enhance their happiness.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Let us see the synonyms **of the given words**:**

 
 
• **Ancient: **Earliest
 
• **Previous: **Preceding
